name: new-angular-feature
description: Standalone component, service, route wiring, and unit tests

agents.task: Create a new Angular standalone component. Include: TypeScript class with proper inputs/outputs, HTML template, SCSS styles. Follow Angular 17+ patterns (standalone: true, inject() for DI, signals where appropriate). Name the component based on the feature context.

Create an Angular service for the feature. Include: injectable service with HttpClient for any API calls, typed interfaces/models for the data, error handling with catchError. Use Angular's inject() function instead of constructor injection.
Wire up the new component to the Angular router. Add a lazy-loaded route to the appropriate routing file. If a nav menu or sidebar exists, add a link to it.

Write unit tests for both the component and the service. Use Jasmine/Jest with TestBed for the component and HttpClientTestingModule for the service. Cover: component renders, service methods return correct data, error states.
